description: Lovejoin: A Cardano-native, non-custodial privacy mixer

contracts.name: Reference Holder
contracts.description: This contract permanently holds the reference token and protocol parameters.

contracts.name: Mix Box v2 (5 ADA)
contracts.description: This contract holds this pool's mix boxes and defers validation to its mix logic.

contracts.name: Mix Logic v2 (5 ADA)
contracts.description: This contract verifies this pool's mix and withdraw proofs once per transaction.

contracts.name: Fee Pool v2 (5 ADA)
contracts.description: This contract holds this pool's shared fee shards that pay for its mix transactions.

contracts.name: Reference Minter v2 (5 ADA)
contracts.description: This contract mints this pool's one-of-one reference token, from its launch's seed.
